title: Merge-at-insertion uses cmd.h instead of cmd.w
description: kt_draw_try_merge line 937 uses cmd.h (height) when computing right edge for horizontal merge adjacency check and width expansion. Post-processing pass kaintana__draw_merge is correctly implemented. Bug causes incorrect merge decisions when w != h.
fix: Changed (int)cmd.h to (int)cmd.w on line 937. gcc -std=c11 -Wall -Wextra -pedantic -Werror clean.
notes: Found during reference audit vs Clay. Z3 proof pending: BUG-023-merge-width.smt2

title: terminal CLI stubs
description: Terminal backend input handling not implemented (raw mode, key reading, mouse). Currently render-only.
fix: Added term_poll_input(): non-blocking stdin -> kt_input_* funnel via stdin_read_byte() (Win32 console API / POSIX select+read), read_escape_sequence() for ANSI CSI/OSC parsing (arrows, F-keys, Home/End, PgUp/Dn), key_to_text() for printable ASCII. Added kt_terminal_set_session() for auto-poll in new_frame(). Added ANSI alt-buf + mouse tracking. Z3: BUG-018-terminal-input-stubs.smt2 (6 invariants verified)
notes: Phase C work. Terminal backend now self-contained: render + input.

title: Descending counting sort O(N*65)
description: Descending path re-scans all N nodes for each of 65 depth buckets: O(65*N). Ascending path uses correct prefix-sum O(N).
fix: Replaced O(65*N) re-scan with O(N) prefix-sum: descending_pos[d] precomputes start position for each depth when sorting descending, then one pass places each element per depth. Z3: BUG-017-damage-counting-sort.smt2 (structural verification)
notes: At 4096 nodes this is 266K iterations vs 4K. Real-world heaps are <64 so both paths fall through to insertion sort.

title: hash_clear sentinel mismatch
description: hash_clear zeroes hash_values to 0, but kt_make initializes to 0xFF. Value 0 is valid root node index, -1 is sentinel for empty.
fix: hash_clear already uses 0xFF memset. No code change needed — status updated to reflect existing fix was already correct.

title: Numeric attribute values passed as integer-to-i8* in slot 7 calls
description: Project-level kaintana-tests.ll ThemeApp_render passes raw integer constants (24, 16, 12, 8) as i8* pointer values to element_set_attr_string (slot 7) for pad/gap attributes. Should use slot 6 (f64). Per-file output is correct — only project-level combine is broken. 10 occurrences. See z__audit/llvm_codegen_bug_1.md.
fix: Route attributes by expected_type (attr_table.c) or stringify numeric values before passing to slot 7. Per-file codegen path handles this correctly.
notes: Crates/sys-codegen/ — attribute lowering pass for project-level combine. BUG-025 blocks clean verify.

title: main() calls surface_loop BEFORE kt_init() — dead kt_* code after surface loop
description: Project-level kaintana-tests.ll main() calls __kain_world_surface_loop_ThemeWorld() before kt_init(). The surface loop never returns, making all subsequent kt_make/backend_register/kt_begin/kt_end/kt_present calls dead code. Per-file output has same bug. native_ui begin_frame likely depends on kt_init() to initialize Kaintana internals (arena, draw batch, node tree).
fix: Reorder main(): move kt_init() and backend registration BEFORE the surface loop call, or embed them in the surface loop function.
notes: Crates/sys-codegen/ — main() emission in entry.rs. Blocks BUG-024 verification.

title: kt_free(NULL) crash
description: kt_free(NULL) calls kaintana__session(NULL) which is just a cast, then sess->vtable dereferences NULL.
fix: Fix was already present in tree.c:148 (`if (!s) return;`). Status updated to reflect existing fix. Z3: bug-015-kt-free-null-guard.smt2 (UNSAT)
notes: Null check already present. Confirmed via read + Z3 proof.

title: hex_nibble returns 0 for invalid chars
description: hex_nibble('G') returns 0. Malformed hex string like "#A0GG00" silently produces wrong color instead of a fallback.
fix: hex_nibble now returns int, returns -1 for invalid chars. kt_color_parse_hex validates every nibble call: if any returns < 0, returns 0xFF000000 fallback. Verified gcc -std=c11 -Wall -Wextra -pedantic -Werror. Z3: bug-014-hex-nibble-invalid.smt2 (UNSAT)
notes: Now safely rejects malformed hex like "#A0GG00" with fallback black (0xFF000000) instead of silently producing wrong color.

title: No test runner exists
description: test_runner.c has not been written. No automated tests verify the pipeline. No CI gate.
fix: Created test_runner.c (~800 lines), Makefile, conftest.py, test_from_specs.py. Parses TSV specs, executes kt_* calls via mini-interpreter, compares golden .bin files, emits JSON. Verified gcc -std=c11 -Wall -Wextra -pedantic -Werror -fsyntax-only.
notes: Phase A deliverable complete: test_runner.c + Makefile + conftest.py + test_from_specs.py.

title: Max load 256 not enforced
description: KAINTANA_HASH_MAX_LOAD=256 but kaintana_hash_insert never checks current load. At 4096 full-table state, lookup probes all slots and returns -1.
fix: Added hash_occupied_count to session struct. Insert checks count >= MAX_LOAD and rejects. Counter incremented on insert, decremented on remove, reset on clear. kaintana_hash_load now O(1).

title: g_active_session singleton
description: v_state_get/set_* dispatch through global g_active_session, not through the sid parameter. Only one session can exist.
fix: Replaced g_active_session with session_by_sid() static array mapping (MAX_SESSIONS=8). All vtable stubs dispatch via sid parameter.
notes: Fixed via session register/lookup array. session_by_sid scans session_map[] by sid.

title: Layout direction hardcoded to row
description: axis=0 hardcoded in box_math.c:231. kt_direction() stores to KaintanaLayout but box_math's pass2 reads hardcoded value.
fix: Added direction, justify_content, align_items fields to KaintanaLayout (replaced part of _pad[]). v_element_set_attr_i64 now stores layout.dir/layout.justify/layout.align to these fields. box_math.c pass2 reads l->direction, l->justify_content, l->align_items instead of hardcoded defaults. Z3: BUG-010-direction-range-safe.smt2 (3 claims verified)
notes: All containers render as horizontal rows regardless of kt_direction setting. Now reads from KaintanaLayout direction field.

title: Root node resolved size = 0
description: Session root (node 0) never gets resolved_width/resolved_height set. Layout pass2 gives children 0 cross-axis size.
fix: Root resolved size set to session dimensions at start of layout_pass2. Added window_width/height to session struct, stored in kt_make(), used in pass2 initialization.
notes: Children have nowhere to lay out.

title: layout_arena_index assigned after attr setters
description: layout_arena_index is -1 for all nodes until kt_end() calls layout_pass1. v_element_set_attr_f64 returns early when index < 0, silently dropping ALL kt_width/kt_height/kt_fill/kt_pad calls.
fix: Layout indices now allocated in node_alloc() (tree.c) instead of deferred to kaintana__layout_pass1(). v_element_set_attr_f64 layout_arena_index < 0 early return relaxed to defensive-only guard.
notes: Attrs are set during tree building (kt_row/kt_fill), but layout indices weren't allocated until kt_end.

title: KaintanaInternalDrawCmd != kt_Cmd type layout
description: kt_present does raw cast from KaintanaInternalDrawCmd* (32 bytes) to kt_Cmd* (44 bytes). Memory layout mismatch produces garbage draw commands.
fix: Replaced raw cast in kt_present with field-by-field conversion loop allocating kt_Cmd array from frame arena. Conversion matches kt_cmd_get() logic: int16 x/y, uint16 w/h to float bounds; corner_radius/256.0f to float radius; color/color_b pass through; data_offset mapped to text_id, texture_handle to image_id. Z3: BUG-007-cmd-conversion-faithful.smt2 (5 claims verified)
notes: kt_cmd_get() does proper per-command conversion but kt_present bypassed it. Fixed by allocating converted kt_Cmd array in kt_present().

title: Attribute dispatch stubs are no-ops
description: v_element_set_attr_* route through vtable stubs that discard all values. kt_fill/kt_width/kt_height silently do nothing. draw_pixels.c explicitly documents this as "task 1.9".
fix: Stored parsed colors in KaintanaLayout.fill_color/stroke_color. v_element_set_attr_string now stores parsed colors. draw_generate reads fill_color from layout instead of hardcoded grey.
notes: The P0 blocker. No element styles take effect. All elements render as default grey at zero size.

title: Empty frames don't present to screen
description: win32_render early-returns on 0-command frames, leaving the DIB framebuffer invisible until a non-empty frame.
fix: Early-return path now calls win32_present_to_screen()

title: Sibling chain cycles on frame re-entry
description: Nodes persist across frames. On frame 2+, kt_row's sibling walk finds the node already in chain and loops forever.
fix: kt_begin() now resets parent/child/sibling links + elem_stack depth each frame
notes: Minecraft UI stress test hit this on frame 2.

title: Arena size insufficient for 450+ elements
description: KAINTANA_ARENA_SIZE=64KB overflows with 2048 nodes + 2048 layouts + caches. Layout SoA struct is ~104 bytes.
fix: Increased to 384KB.

title: Node capacity hardcoded at 128
description: kt_make sets node_capacity=128 with no growth mechanism. Node alloc returns -1 when full. Any UI with >128 elements silently drops elements.
fix: Increased to 2048 for now. Growth mechanism still TODO.
notes: Minecraft stress test (450+ elements) hit this immediately.

title: Root node sentinels not initialized
description: nodes[0].first_child and next_sibling are 0 (from calloc) instead of -1. kt_row's sibling walk while(n->next_sibling>=0) becomes infinite loop.
fix: Added explicit -1 initialization in kt_make() after root node alloc
notes: Seen during hello_kaintana.c first ever run. Root cause of infinite hang.

title: win32_enable_dpi uses V1 instead of V2 API
description: win32_enable_dpi() now tries SetProcessDpiAwarenessContext(DPI_AWARENESS_CONTEXT_PER_MONITOR_AWARE_V2) from user32.dll (V2, Win 10 1703+) first, then falls back to SetProcessDpiAwareness from shcore.dll (V1, Win 8.1+). V2 uses scoped-block pragma guards for clean push/pop.
fix: V2 via user32.dll SetProcessDpiAwarenessContext, V1 fallback via shcore.dll SetProcessDpiAwareness. Verified gcc -std=c11 -Wall -Wextra -pedantic -Werror.

title: WM_ERASEBKGND not suppressed
description: The window proc does not handle WM_ERASEBKGND. DefWindowProcW paints the background brush (COLOR_WINDOW+1 from WNDCLASSEXW.hbrBackground) which causes a brief white flash before the first render. Old KUIF returned 1 to suppress.
fix: Added case WM_ERASEBKGND: return 1; to win32_wndproc(). Verified gcc -std=c11 -Wall -Wextra -pedantic -Werror.

title: CW_USEDEFAULT can create off-screen windows
description: Host creates window with CW_USEDEFAULT position. Old KUIF used explicit 100,100 to avoid off-screen coords on multi-monitor setups.
fix: Replaced CW_USEDEFAULT, CW_USEDEFAULT with 100, 100 in CreateWindowExW call. Verified gcc -std=c11 -Wall -Wextra -pedantic -Werror.
